item.title: Jay-Z’s Yankee Stadium Night Two Setlist: Every Song Played at the Second Show
item.description:
[Energetic music fades out, and the host begins speaking]
Host: "Welcome back to the show, everyone! Tonight, we're coming at you live from Yankee Stadium, where Jay-Z is killing it on the second night of his three-day residency. The King of New York, the King of Rap, is celebrating a major milestone - 25 years of his iconic album, The Blueprint.
[Short music clip from "The Blueprint" plays]
Host: "Jay-Z performed the entire album, bringing out special guests like Slick Rick, Eminem, and Pharrell to join in on the fun. The crowd went wild when Eminem surprised them with a performance of 'Loose Yourself', and Pharrell brought the house down with hits like 'Frontin' and 'Excuse Me Miss'.
[Short music clip from "Frontin'" plays]
Host: "The energy was electric, with the crowd singing along to almost every one of the nearly 30 songs performed. From 'Hola Hovito' to 'U Don’t Know', Jay-Z showed why he's still the king of the game. And with one night left, we can't wait to see what he has in store for fans. Stay tuned for more updates, and get ready for an epic finale to this unforgettable weekend!"
[Music fades out, and the host ends with a teaser]
Host: "Check out the full setlist from Night Two of Jay-Z's Yankee Stadium run, and we'll catch you on the flip side!"
